# `jouet claim release`

- **Usage:** `jouet claim release [PATHS]…`

Release this session's claims

Releases the claims on the paths given, or all of this session's claims in this repository. Another session's claim is never released: it lapses on its own.

## Arguments
- **`[PATHS]…`** — The claimed paths to release; all of this session's when none

## Flags
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
